plain: A setting for how much randomness a language model uses when it picks its words; above zero, the same question can get different answers.
eli5: A dial for how surprising the robot's answer is: turned down it says the same thing every time, turned up it mixes things up.
technical: The softmax temperature T scales the logits before sampling: T → 0 approaches greedy decoding, larger T flattens the token distribution. Even at T = 0, batching and non-deterministic kernels can change outputs.
